evidence.title: GitHub - michaelshimeles/skills: Agent skills and an AGENTS.md workflow template

name: michaelshimeles/skills
summary: Seven Claude Code agent skills plus an AGENTS.md workflow template for worktrees, evidence and review loops.
description: A collection of seven agent skills for Claude Code, each a folder with a SKILL.md that loads when a task matches: worktree isolation, service-layer structure, evidence-driven testing, before/after screenshot proof, Greptile review loops and an unslop writing pass. AGENTS.md ties them together as isolate, build, prove, ship; install with npx skills.
contains: 7 skills: before-and-after, code-structure, evidence-driven-testing, greploop, greploop-apps, new-feature, unslop
AGENTS.md template chains the skills: isolate, build, prove, ship
evidence-driven-testing records video proof via scripts/evidence.py (Python 3 + FFmpeg) and posts it to the PR
greploop iterates until Greptile reports 5/5 with zero unresolved comments (default max 10)
each skill installs with npx skills
